title: ELP1 and BDP1 reductions activate an ATF4 amino-acid-starvation module in susceptible thalamic neurons
exact_observed_result: Elp1 induced an ATF4-like amino-acid-starvation panel across susceptible neurons, Bdp1 induced a concordant 151 TH Ddit3/aminoacyl-tRNA-synthetase state, and Trmt1 did not induce the same Elp1/Elp2 ISR-like module in 151 TH.
biological_interpretation: Elongator loss and Pol III initiation stress sensitize a thalamic tRNA/translation pathway that is not a generic consequence of every tRNA-modification perturbation.

evidence_records.statistics: 153 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 645 genes at FDR<0.05. Cars logFC 1.12 score 11.92 FDR 1.53e-28; Chac1 logFC 3.43 score 11.83 FDR 2.28e-28; Asns logFC 1.46 score 11.64 FDR 1.50e-27; Ddit3 logFC 1.57 FDR 3.13e-20; Atf4 logFC 1.57 FDR 4.66e-9; Adgrb1 logFC -0.677 FDR 1.32e-20; Srsf5 logFC -0.543 FDR 4.79e-14.
evidence_records.description: The dominant Elp1 response was a large amino-acid-stress-like program in this thalamic glutamatergic class.

evidence_records.statistics: 54 perturbed cells versus 6961 controls; 29 genes at FDR<0.05. Asns logFC 1.35 FDR 6.50e-4; Mars1 logFC 0.914 FDR 6.50e-4; Ddx17 logFC -0.652 FDR 6.50e-4; Aldh1l2 logFC 3.21 FDR 0.00171; Atf4 logFC 1.77 FDR 0.00171; Srsf5 logFC -0.538 FDR 0.00344; Chac1 logFC 2.18 p=1.46e-4 FDR 0.0625.
evidence_records.description: A smaller but coherent amino-acid-stress response recurred in the MH-LH/TH glutamatergic class.

evidence_records.statistics: 128 perturbed cells versus 20353 controls; 12 genes at FDR<0.05. Srsf5 logFC -0.637 FDR 3.65e-12; Aldh1l2 logFC 1.44 FDR 1.23e-5; Cars logFC 0.709 FDR 1.23e-5; Slc1a4 logFC 1.12 FDR 0.00517; Chac1 logFC 1.75 FDR 0.00517; Mars1 logFC 0.610 FDR 0.00844; Lars logFC 0.583 FDR 0.00884; Ddx17 logFC -0.341 FDR 0.0260.
evidence_records.description: Midbrain glutamatergic Elp1-perturbed cells showed a compact version of the same stress signature.

evidence_records.statistics: 64 perturbed cells versus 10309 controls; 10 genes at FDR<0.05. Cars logFC 0.957 FDR 3.43e-7; Srsf5 logFC -0.625 FDR 5.42e-5; Aldh1l2 logFC 1.64 FDR 2.63e-4; Slc7a5 logFC 1.79 FDR 0.00212; Mars1 logFC 0.839 FDR 0.00276; Mthfd2 logFC 2.04 FDR 0.0292.
evidence_records.description: A GABAergic midbrain/pons/medulla class also carried the Elp1 amino-acid-stress axis.

evidence_records.statistics: 93 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; 8 genes reached FDR<0.05: Ddit3 logFC 1.031, FDR 0.00572; Mars1 0.605, FDR 0.00572; Iars 0.734, FDR 0.0120; Lars 0.663, FDR 0.0120; Aars 0.624, FDR 0.0120; Cars 0.683, FDR 0.0151; Kcnc2 -0.234, FDR 0.0207; Yars 0.706, FDR 0.0429.
evidence_records.description: The only Bdp1 cell type with FDR-significant genes showed up-regulation of six cytosolic aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase genes plus Ddit3 and a down-regulated Kcnc2.

evidence_records.statistics: Bdp1 DE covered 338339 gene-by-cell-type rows across 20 cell types; all 8 FDR<0.05 rows were in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; the other 19 cell types each had 0 FDR<0.05 genes, with minimum within-cell-type FDR values from 0.190 to 1.000.
evidence_records.description: Multiple-testing-significant Bdp1 responses were restricted to one glutamatergic thalamic class.

evidence_records.statistics: 052 Pvalb Gaba had 103 perturbed cells and 3 FDR<0.05 genes: Ndufs8 FDR 0.035, Zfp961 FDR 0.035, Asns FDR 0.0479. 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA had 65 perturbed cells and 1 FDR<0.05 gene: Srsf5 logFC -0.566, score -5.09, FDR 0.00601.
evidence_records.description: Two additional GABAergic classes showed only one to three FDR hits including one recurrent stress marker each.

evidence_records.statistics: 15 of 21 tested Elp1 cell types had zero genes at FDR<0.05 despite 35 to 117 perturbed cells per class; examples: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut had 117 perturbed cells and max |score| 4.00; 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut had Elp1 logFC -0.530 but zero FDR genes; 308 CB GABA had Elp1 logFC -0.688 but zero FDR genes.
evidence_records.description: Most cell classes were FDR-silent for Elp1, including several with nominal target-transcript depletion or moderate perturbed-cell counts.

evidence_records.statistics: Elp2 had 141 perturbed cells versus 23679 controls; Elp2 transcript logFC -0.601, score -3.84, p=1.25e-4, FDR 0.0198. Elp2 produced 150 FDR<0.05 genes and was the top non-Elp1 neighbor of the Elp1 top-100 signature among 2046 perturbations, cosine 0.974 and Pearson r 0.971.
evidence_records.description: The other assayed Elongator core subunit phenocopied Elp1 in the strongest responsive cell type.

evidence_records.statistics: Using the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut top-100 Elp1 genes, cosine similarity was 0.573 for Alkbh8, 0.332 for Nsun2, and 0.210 for Eif2ak4. Representative Elp1 markers Cars, Chac1, Asns, and Slc3a2 did not pass FDR<0.05 in those three comparator signatures.
evidence_records.description: Preselected RNA-modification or stress-sensor comparators did not reproduce the Elp1/Elp2 signature.

evidence_records.statistics: In 22 Nsun2 and 20 Alkbh8 cell-type signatures, no Nsun2 or Alkbh8 contrast had any FDR<0.05 gene; Trmt1-versus-Nsun2 Pearson correlations of gene-level scores ranged from -0.106 to 0.061, and Trmt1-versus-Alkbh8 correlations ranged from -0.092 to 0.107 over matched measured genes.
evidence_records.description: Comparison of Trmt1 with two assayed tRNA modification neighbors showed no shared score signature.

caveats: The Bdp1 response is weaker and more thalamus-restricted than the Elp1 response, and the Trmt1 comparator is interpreted as non-interchangeability rather than evidence that TRMT1 biology is absent.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.

citations.citation: Goffena J et al. Elongator and codon bias regulate protein levels in mammalian peripheral neurons. Nat Commun. 2018;9:889.
citations.supports: Showed that IKBKAP/ELP1 encodes the Elongator scaffold and that Elongator loss alters codon-biased protein expression in mammalian peripheral neurons.

citations.citation: Shan J et al. The C/ebp-Atf response element location reveals two distinct Atf4-dependent, elongation-mediated mechanisms for transcriptional induction of aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase genes in response to amino acid limitation. Nucleic Acids Res. 2016;44(20):9719-9732.
citations.supports: Demonstrated that amino acid limitation induces most cytoplasmic aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase genes through Atf4-dependent CARE enhancers.

citations.citation: Vasudevan D et al. Translational induction of ATF4 during integrated stress response requires noncanonical initiation factors eIF2D and DENR. Nat Commun. 2020;11:4677.
citations.supports: Summarized ATF4 induction as a core effector of the metazoan integrated stress response to amino acid deprivation and ER stress.

citations.citation: Waszak SM et al. Germline Elongator mutations in Sonic Hedgehog medulloblastoma. Nature. 2020;580(7803):396-401.
citations.supports: Linked germline ELP1 loss-of-function to Sonic Hedgehog medulloblastoma and reported destabilized Elongator, loss of wobble tRNA modifications, codon-dependent translational reprogramming, and unfolded protein response induction in ELP1-associated tumors.

citations.citation: UniProtKB entries A6H8Y1 BDP1_HUMAN and Q571C7 BDP1_MOUSE.
citations.supports: Curated BDP1 function, homology to mouse Bdp1, nuclear localization, TFIIIB subunit membership, and links to RNA polymerase III promoter-initiation pathways.

citations.citation: Reactome RNA Polymerase III Transcription Initiation From Type 1/2/3 Promoter pathways: R-HSA-76061, R-HSA-76066 and R-HSA-76071.
citations.supports: Places BDP1 in RNA polymerase III transcription initiation at all three promoter classes.

citations.supports: Review defining ATF4 and DDIT3/CHOP as hallmark ISR outputs with context-dependent adaptation or apoptosis.

citations.citation: Slaugenhaupt SA et al. Tissue-specific expression of a splicing mutation in the IKBKAP gene causes familial dysautonomia. Am J Hum Genet. 2001;68(3):598-605.

citations.supports: Reported a homozygous ELP1 missense mutation causing intellectual disability and global developmental delay and showed impaired ELP123 tRNA binding and Elongator function.

citations.supports: Provided preclinical evidence that increasing correct ELP1 splicing can rescue proprioceptive sensory phenotypes, supporting restoration of ELP1 expression as a therapeutic direction.
